hero.title: Your brand, on my first car.
hero.subtitle: Your logo rides with me for 6 months. Pick your spot, place your bid.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1Body: Six zones on the car, priced by visibility.
howItWorks.step2Body: The top bid at week's end wins. I'll reach out to arrange the balance.
howItWorks.step3Body: I print your logo as a vinyl sticker and your brand travels with me for 6 months.

benefits.title: What else you get
benefits.devBody: I'm a software developer. Part of what you contribute translates into work for your brand: a website, an app, an automation, or a bot, scoped to the amount.
benefits.contentBody: I'll be filming a lot of car content for social — your brand shows up branded, organically, in that content.
benefits.callBody: Once I have the car, I'll show you your sticker live over FaceTime if you'd like to see it.

faq.title: Questions & Answers
faq.paymentA: Bidding takes a 20% deposit (minimum equivalent to €10). If you're outbid, it's refunded automatically. If you win, it counts toward the total and I send a payment link for the remainder.
faq.outbidA: You get a full refund and the chance to swing back. A new bid must beat the current one by at least €10.
faq.approvalA: I approve every sponsor by hand before it appears. If your bid is refused, your deposit comes back in full.
